 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing a real estate project named and styled as “ ZAMEEN ACE MALL ”, comprising of inter alia commercial shops, hotel apartments and residential apartments located at Plot No . 36A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, Phase II, DHA, Islamabad (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the plan for the Project and is desirous to purchase the shop ( s ) as described in the Description of Purchased Unit (“ Purchased Unit ”), along with leaseback to the Developer with respect thereto ; and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer and to take on lease the same from the Buyer, on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase Price, the Developer will sell the rights in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer , subject to leaseback to the Developer and in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale , purchase and leaseback of the Purchased Unit , all of which shall form an integral part of this Agreement to Sell (the “Agreement” ): 
 
 Description of Purchased Unit; 
 This Agreement to Sell; 
 Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit &amp; Nominees Form; 
 Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions; 
 Leaseback Agreement ; 
 Appendix A: Payment Plan; 
 Appendix B: Purchased Unit Floor Plan; 
 Appendix C: List of Material s ; and 
 Any other document incorporated by reference in this Agreement . 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Purchased Unit . Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 
 BUYER’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have signed the Agreement, having fully understood the conditions set forth therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses:

 SCHEDULE B 
 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.3 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Purchased Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of all Purchased Unit s, including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies, Parking Space and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Purchased Unit s and do not form part of any given Purchased Unit . 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement. 
 
 Completion or Estimated Completion Date 
 means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause s 3 (Payment) and 5 (Construction and Possession of the Purchased Unit ) of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the Project. 
 
 Developer means ZUI INVESTMENTS with its office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore . 
 
 Down Payment means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties in writing. 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment, including the payments mentioned in the Payment Plan, is required to be paid by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 1 5 .1 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment (including Down Payment) to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan. For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may, subject to Clause 3.3, include any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 
 Lease back Agreement means the lease back agreement executed by and between the Developer and the Buyer whereby the Buyer has leased back the Purchased Unit to the Developer pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Leaseback Agreement appended to th e Agreement . 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of maintaining, operating or managing the Project or any part thereof, including, inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Nominee means such person, as may be nominated by the Buyer as the person who may facilitate in the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer, under the Agreement to Sell, to Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of demise of the Buyer. 
 
 Parking Space means the parking space allocated for the use of the Buyer, visitor or occupants of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 Party means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Appendix A of the Agreement to Sell, setting out the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer. 
 
 Permitted Use means the permissible nature and use of the Purchased Unit as per the Purchased Unit type specified in the Description of the Purchased Unit , strictly in accordance with the Rules (defined below). 
 
 Project means the real estate project, named and styled as ‘ Zameen Ace Mall ’ , being constructed and developed by the Developer at Plot No. 36A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard , DHA , Islamabad. 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Buyer to purchase the Purchased Unit (exclusive of tax) including Component Materials, (as specified in Appendix C ), in the manner and in such instalments , as identified in the Payment Plan in Appendix A to the Agreement to Sell, as may be modified in terms hereof including under Clause 10 .2 and any Adjusted Amount in terms of Clause 3.3 of the Agreement. 
 
 Purchased Unit means the fully constructed and finished , commercial shop, as specifically described in Schedule A and shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan , which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Agreement . 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit and its location, as shown in Appendix B to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Rent has the meaning assigned to it in the Lease back Agreement. 
 
 Rules means such rules as may be framed by the Developer and/or the Management Company and amended from time to time setting out the Buyer’s / Occupant’s rights and obligations in relation to the transfer/resale, use, occupancy, layout, maintenance, design and display of the all Purchased Unit s. 
 
 Service Charges Advance means the Service Charges payable by the Buyer to the Management Company in advance at the time of Completion and in accordance with Clause 3.1(ii) of the General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Service Charges means the amount payable periodically by the Buyer to the Management Company bi - annually in advance , pursuant to the management agreement to be executed between the Parties, as a service charge fee for management, administration, maintenance and control of the Project, without limitation the Purchased Unit , Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Space. The amount of Service Charge shall be determined by the Management Company in its absolute discretion. 
 
 Taxes means any federal, provincial or local taxes or levies payable on any component used for the construction of the Purchased Unit (including the Component Materials) or, where the context permits, applicable on the sale or lease thereof . 
 
 Other Purchased Unit (s) means any one or more commercial shop or other type of unit in the Project, other than the Purchased Unit . 
 
 1.2. Except where the context otherwise requires, references in the Agreement to: 
 
 An Article, Clause, attachment, or paragraph are reference to an Article, Clause, attachment or paragraph of the Agreement or the relevant document comprising the Agreement; 
 
 Any headings in the Agreement are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 
 Any reference to a date or time is to such date and time in Islamabad, Pakistan; 
 
 Any reference to a Party shall, where the context permits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns; 
 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Agreement or any part of the Agreement; 
 
 Use of the terms “including”, “include” or “includes” shall be interpreted to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, unless otherwise specified; 
 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing include an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 
 “law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 
 Where there is a reference to “sell”, “sale” or other transfer of rights in any Purchased Unit by the Developer to the Buyer, such term refers to a sale of the Developer’s rights relating to the Purchased Unit concerned, including the right to occupy and use such Purchased Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to the General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 2.1 The Developer agrees to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, along with all rights, title and interest of the Developer therein, for a total sale consideration equal to the Purchase Price , and subject to the leaseback of the Purchased Unit to the Developer, strictly in accordance with the Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 2.2 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that only the title of the Purchased Unit shall be transferred to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall have no rights, title or interest in the Project other than the limited rights of access to Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Space as expressly provided herein. For the avoidance of doubt, the Developer shall at all times have all rights, title and interest with respect to the Common Areas, Common Facilities, Parking Space, roof and exterior walls.
